_comment: The 30 lines Raj records for runs 3 and 4 (mist-model-host plan v2, host step H3). Kind `complete` is a finished request; kind `pause` carries a mid-thought pause of about one second at the `...` mark, where end of turn must not call the turn finished. Invented text, no personal data.

utterances.text: Set a timer for ten minutes.
What's on my calendar tomorrow morning?
Turn the living room lights down to thirty percent.
Remind me to call the dentist on Monday at nine.
How long would it take to drive to the airport right now?
Play something calm, maybe some piano, not too loud.
What did we decide about the database migration last week?
Add oat milk, eggs and coffee filters to the shopping list.
Cancel the alarm for six thirty and set one for seven fifteen instead.
Is it going to rain this afternoon?
Show me the report on the second monitor.
Close that window and bring the chart back up.
Read me the last message from the build server.
What time is it in Tokyo right now?
Sum up what I worked on today in two sentences.
Pause the music and turn the volume down a bit.
How many steps did I take yesterday compared to the day before?
Okay, that's enough for tonight. Go to sleep.
Spell the word necessary for me, slowly.
Tell me something interesting about octopuses.
Can you remind me to ... pick up the parcel tomorrow?
Set an alarm for ... actually, make it seven thirty.
What was the name of that ... the restaurant we tried last month?
Turn on the ... kitchen lights, please.
I want to ... no, wait, show me the calendar first.
Add a note that says ... call the landlord about the heating.
How far is it from here to ... the coast?
So the thing I keep forgetting is ... where I put the spare keys.
Play the playlist from ... last Sunday's run.
Can you check whether ... the backup finished last night?
